guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Add Robinhood Chain to Your Wallet
guide.description: Robinhood Wallet supports the chain by default (see our Robinhood Chain guide for setup basics). For MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet, add Robinhood Chain manually (chain ID 4663, ETH for gas).

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to Fables

guide.title: Deposit Liquidity Into a Fables Market
guide.description: Go to the deposit section and choose an eligible market: ETH/USDG: crypto pair with round-the-clock trading SPY/USDG: tokenized S&P 500 ETF GLD/USDG: tokenized gold ETF TSLA/USDG: tokenized Tesla stock Pick a price range, enter your ETH or USDG amount, and confirm the transaction. Other supported tokens work too.

guide.title: Keep Your Position in Range
guide.description: Positions earn swap fees, and therefore points, only while the price sits inside your range. Check your position regularly and adjust the range when the price moves out.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
